chunks: Do not spend the nights of Tashreeq except in Mina. If you spend them elsewhere, then a sheep's blood-sacrifice is due from you for each night.
And if you leave Mina at the beginning of the night, then midnight must not arrive except while you are in Mina, or after you have already departed from Mecca.
Except if you are occupied with your tawaf and your sa'i, and you find yourself in Mecca in the morning; then there is nothing upon you.
And if you leave after midnight, it does not harm you to spend the morning elsewhere.

key_terms.أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ: the beginning part of the night
key_terms.دَمُ شَاةٍ: the sacrifice of a sheep as expiation
key_terms.سَعْيِكَ: your sa'i, the ritual walking between Safa and Marwah
key_terms.طَوَافِكَ: your tawaf, the ritual circumambulation of the Ka'bah
key_terms.لَيَالِيَ التَّشْرِيقِ: the nights of Tashreeq during the days of hajj after Eid al-Adha
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the hajj site where pilgrims stay during these nights
key_terms.نِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ: midnight, the legal threshold mentioned in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on spending the nights of Tashreeq outside Mina during hajj?
ai.summary: This text gives a fiqh ruling concerning spending the nights of Tashreeq in Mina during hajj. It states the obligation of staying in Mina, the compensatory sacrifice for missing a night, and the exceptions related to leaving before or after midnight and being occupied with tawaf and sa'i in Mecca.
